title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers filled with seasoned ground beef, rice and tomatoes, topped with melted cheese and baked until tender.

image.alt: Bell peppers stuffed with rice and beef, topped with melted cheese

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 375F oven}. Stand the peppers upright in the baking dish, trimming the bottoms slightly if they wobble.
Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the beef with the onion, breaking it up, {time 8 min}. Add the garlic, oregano, paprika and salt for {time 1 min}.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, cooked rice and half the tomato sauce and simmer for {time 3 min}.
Fill the peppers with the mixture, mounding it on top. Spoon the rest of the sauce over them and pour {qty 1/4 cup} water into the dish.
Cover with foil and bake until the peppers are tender, {time 30-35 min}. Uncover, top with cheese and bake until melted and bubbly, {time 10 min}.

notes: Leftover rice works perfectly here. Stuffed peppers freeze well, cooked or uncooked, for up to 3 months.
